Authors and provenance

Components and licences

InsertCreator combines its application code with libraries, fonts, an image processing model and geometry assets from other authors. This page records their origins and links to the complete licence texts.

Licence of the application’s own code

The repository does not yet declare an overall licence for InsertCreator’s own code. The open licences below apply to the specific components listed; they do not automatically grant the same rights to the entire application. Publishing source code does not by itself provide an open-source licence.

FreeCAD-library digital caliper

Digital_caliper · author hasecilu

CC BY 3.0

The source model comes from the FreeCAD Parts Library. Attribution: Digital caliper by hasecilu, FreeCAD-library, CC BY 3.0. When sharing the asset or adaptations, provide the author, source, licence link and the applicable changes.

Modifications for InsertCreator: the mesh was split into connected components. Every component except the beam was moved 69.0 mm along the beam to close the outside jaws. The result was projected into a top view, the projected triangles were unioned, the beam aligned with X, and the outline simplified using Douglas–Peucker with a 0.1 mm tolerance. The catalogue outline is labelled as a typical shape.

  • Complete bundled CC BY 3.0 licence
  • Exact provenance and full modification notes
  • Original asset at the recorded revision
  • CC BY 3.0 terms

References, development tools and sharing

Project references to Gridfinity, DIN/ISO and other design or dimensional references do not by themselves mean their program code was adopted. Dimensional compatibility, inspiration, imported models and imported libraries are different things; the specific reused components are listed above.

Development and testing also use @napi-rs/canvas 1.1.0 (MIT), happy-dom 21.0.4 (MIT) and pdfjs-dist 4.10.38 (Apache 2.0). These are not part of the static application published from dist/.

When redistributing: keep the complete licence texts for the applicable components. When sharing derived catalogue models, preserve the attribution their licences require. Current project and manufacturing exports do not automatically attach all of these details; add them when sharing the FreeCAD-derived asset, for example in an accompanying README.

This page is a summary. The linked licence texts and provenance documents contain the complete terms.
